input: I was promised a promotional interest rate when I opened my savings account, but after the first month, the rate dropped significantly without any notification. Please also review your direct mail marketing to ensure all rate-related disclaimers are clearly displayed as required by law.
output: Complaint about Pre-Approved Loan Offer Rate Not Honored

input: I have been trying to unlink an old savings account from my online banking profile for months. Every time I delete it, it reappears the next time I log in. I contacted tech support and was told this is a 'known issue' but no resolution timeline was provided. The old account is from a closed relationship and its presence is causing confusion in my transaction history. Please fix this bug and confirm when it will be resolved. It is unacceptable to acknowledge a known bug and leave customers dealing with it indefinitely.
output: Complaint about Persistent Deleted Account Reappearing in Online Banking

input: I received a tax form 1099-INT showing more interest income than I actually earned in my savings account. The discrepancy is over $300, which will result in me overpaying taxes if I use the form as issued. I have calculated the correct interest based on my monthly statements and they do not match. I need a corrected 1099-INT issued before the tax filing deadline. Please also audit your interest reporting systems to ensure all 1099s issued to customers are accurate.
output: Complaint about Incorrect 1099-INT Tax Form

input: I requested a bank reference letter for a visa application to another country. Your bank took four weeks to produce a simple one-page letter confirming my account standing. By the time I received it, the visa appointment I had scheduled had already passed and I had to rebook, delaying my trip by two months. For an important document that requires accurate account information, a four-week turnaround is completely unacceptable. I would like compensation for the visa rescheduling fee and apology for the delay.
output: Complaint about Excessive Delay in Producing Bank Reference Letter

input: I signed up for your bank's premium account tier which includes free international wire transfers. However, every time I initiate an international transfer, I am charged the standard $45 wire fee. I have to call after each transfer to have the fee reversed, which wastes my time. This is a feature of my account tier and should be applied automatically. I want all previously charged wire fees refunded and assurance that the system will be corrected immediately. Please test premium account benefits before advertising them.
output: Complaint about Premium Account Wire Transfer Benefit Not Applied

input: I opened a certificate of deposit and specifically requested the early withdrawal penalty be waived in the event of my death or disability, which your representative said was a standard option. When I recently became disabled and needed to access the funds, the branch refused to waive the penalty. I was never given documentation of this option being added to my account. I want the early withdrawal penalty waived given my disability and the verbal commitment made at account opening. Please also ensure verbal commitments from representatives are documented.
output: Complaint about Disability Early Withdrawal Penalty Not Honored

input: Your bank implemented a new two-factor authentication system for online banking without adequate notice. The system requires a phone call to a number I no longer have access to. I am now completely locked out of my account. When I called support, I was told account recovery requires visiting a branch in person, but I live over 100 miles from the nearest branch. I need a remote account recovery option immediately. Please also provide adequate notice before implementing authentication changes that could lock customers out.
output: Complaint about Two-Factor Authentication Lockout with No Remote Recovery

input: I disputed a charge from a subscription service I had cancelled. The merchant provided your dispute team with a screenshot of a terms of service agreement, but the agreement shown is from a different version of their service than I subscribed to. Your team closed the dispute in the merchant's favor without reviewing my evidence. I have email confirmation of my cancellation. I want the dispute reopened with proper review of all documentation. Please establish clearer standards for what evidence merchants must provide in disputes.
output: Complaint about Dispute Closed Based on Incorrect Merchant Evidence

input: My credit card statement shows a minimum payment due date that differs from the payment due date shown in your mobile app. I paid by the date shown in the app but was still charged a late fee. This is entirely your system's fault for showing inconsistent information. I want the late fee waived and both systems corrected to show the same date. I also want confirmation that this discrepancy has not affected my credit report. Please audit all customer-facing payment due date displays for consistency.
output: Complaint about Inconsistent Payment Due Date Causing Late Fee

input: I applied for a small business credit card and was denied despite having an 800+ personal credit score and a profitable business for six years. The denial reason provided was 'insufficient business revenue' but I submitted my tax returns showing strong revenue. When I asked for a reconsideration, I was told it was not possible. I would like a detailed explanation of exactly how my application was evaluated and an opportunity for manual review by a senior credit analyst. Please provide clear criteria for small business credit card approvals.
output: Complaint about Unjustified Small Business Credit Card Denial

input: I use your foreign currency account feature to hold euros for regular international payments. Your bank recently changed the fee structure for this account type without adequate notice, significantly increasing my transaction costs. The change was buried in a terms update email with no clear highlight of the fee increase. I would like to be grandfathered into the original fee structure or given the option to close the account without penalty. Please provide more prominent notice of fee changes that materially affect customers.
output: Complaint about Hidden Foreign Currency Account Fee Increase

input: I purchased travel insurance through your bank's credit card benefits and submitted a claim for trip interruption due to a medical emergency. The claim was denied because the insurance company says the emergency was a 'pre-existing condition,' but this condition was diagnosed after I purchased the tickets. I have a doctor's letter confirming the diagnosis date. I would like the denial reviewed and overturned. Please also clarify how pre-existing conditions are defined in your travel insurance policy and provide better guidance to customers at enrollment.
output: Complaint about Travel Insurance Claim Denied for Pre-Existing Condition

input: I have a linked account with a partner bank through your premium banking network. Your bank recently made changes that broke the account linking feature, and now I cannot view or transfer to my partner bank account. I have contacted both banks and each says the issue is the other's responsibility. I have been without this important functionality for three weeks. I need someone with authority at your bank to take ownership of resolving this interbank connectivity issue. Please establish clear ownership processes for partner bank technical issues.
output: Complaint about Broken Partner Bank Account Linking

input: I submitted an application to open a trust account to hold assets for my minor children. Your bank requested documents, I submitted them, and then received no communication for six weeks. When I followed up, I was told the application had been closed due to 'incomplete documentation' but no one contacted me to request additional documents. I would like the application reopened with a dedicated relationship manager assigned. Please also implement a communication protocol for trust account applications that keeps applicants informed of required actions.
output: Complaint about Trust Account Application Closed Without Notification

input: I was charged a returned item fee when a check I deposited was returned by the issuing bank. While I understand this policy, your bank also placed an extended hold on all my future deposits for six months without any prior notice or an opportunity to appeal. This hold is severely impacting my small business operations. I have not had any previous returned items in my 10-year banking history. I would like the extended hold policy reviewed and lifted given my long clean history.
output: Complaint about Extended Deposit Hold Policy Applied Without Notice

input: Your bank's online account opening process collected my personal information but then failed to complete the application due to a technical error. I received no confirmation and when I tried to reapply, I was told my information was already in the system but the application could not be located. I am concerned about what happened to my personal data. I need clarification on whether my information was properly secured and the application either completed or my data deleted. Please also fix the technical failure in your online account opening system.
output: Complaint about Failed Online Account Opening and Data Privacy Concern

input: I received a promotional offer for zero percent interest balance transfers with a 2% transfer fee. I completed the transfer as instructed but was subsequently charged the regular interest rate of 21.9% on the transferred balance. When I called, I was told the promotional rate had 'already expired' even though I applied and completed the transfer before the offer end date. I have screenshots of the offer with the expiry date. I want the promotional rate applied retroactively and interest charges reversed.
output: Complaint about Balance Transfer Promotional Rate Not Applied

input: I have been trying to update my home address with your bank for two months. Each time I update it online or in the app, it reverts to my old address within days. I have also tried updating it at the branch and over the phone. My new address update keeps failing and I am missing important correspondence. Please escalate this to your technology team as it is clearly a systemic bug. I also need confirmation that all recent statements and notifications have been resent to my correct current address.
output: Complaint about Persistent Address Update Failure Across All Channels

input: I applied for a secured credit card to rebuild my credit and provided the required security deposit of $500. The card was issued but when I checked my credit report, the account is not being reported to any of the three major bureaus. The entire purpose of a secured card is to build credit history. I contacted your bank and was told it 'may take several months' to appear on credit reports. Other secured cards report monthly. Please confirm when my account will be reported and provide back-dated reporting for the months already missed.
output: Complaint about Secured Credit Card Not Reporting to Credit Bureaus

input: I asked your bank to place a deceased spouse's portion of a joint CD into an estate account. Your representative incorrectly closed the entire CD and sent me a check for the full amount, triggering an early withdrawal penalty on the portion that was not yet matured. I did not authorize the full closure. I want the penalty refunded and an explanation of how this error occurred. Please also provide better training for your representatives on handling CDs in estate situations.
output: Complaint about Incorrect CD Early Closure During Estate Settlement

input: I submitted a formal written complaint to your bank's complaints department three months ago and have received no acknowledgment or response. This complaint related to a $2,000 billing error that remains unresolved. Many jurisdictions require banks to respond to written complaints within specific timeframes. I am formally requesting your complaints team to respond within seven days, or I will be filing a complaint with the relevant financial regulator. Please also implement a complaint tracking system that ensures no customer complaint goes unanswered.
output: Complaint about Formal Complaint Left Completely Unanswered

input: I signed up for your bank's credit monitoring service which promises to alert me of any changes to my credit report within 24 hours. I recently discovered my credit score had dropped by 80 points due to a fraudulent account opened in my name over two months ago, and I received zero alerts from your monitoring service during that time. I am now dealing with the consequences of identity theft that could have been caught earlier. I want the credit monitoring fee refunded and a thorough explanation of why the alerts failed.
output: Complaint about Failed Credit Monitoring Alert Service

input: My debit card was skimmed and unauthorized transactions totaling $1,200 were made from my account. I reported the fraud immediately. Your bank reversed most transactions but left one disputed item of $350 unresolved, claiming I 'made the transaction.' I was out of the country when this transaction occurred and have passport stamps to prove it. I want this final $350 reimbursed immediately and a thorough investigation into how the skimming occurred. Please also improve your card skimming detection systems.
output: Complaint about Unresolved Card Skimming Reimbursement

input: I have a business line of credit and attempted to draw on it during a critical cash flow period. The draw was declined because your system had not processed my most recent principal payment, even though it cleared my account five days earlier. As a result, I had to delay paying suppliers, damaging important business relationships. I need the credit line access restored immediately and confirmation that my payment has been properly applied. Please also fix the delay in your payment processing and credit availability system.
output: Complaint about Business Line of Credit Draw Declined Due to Processing Delay

input: Your bank sent me a check for the incorrect amount as a refund for an overpayment. The check was for $45 less than what I was owed. When I called to report the discrepancy, I was told I would need to return the original check and wait for a new one to be issued. This process will take 2-3 weeks for a bank error of less than $50. Please issue a supplemental payment for the $45 difference immediately without requiring me to go through the full reissue process. Please also improve your refund calculation accuracy.
output: Complaint about Refund Check Issued for Incorrect Amount

input: I enrolled in your bank's rent reporting service which promises to report on-time rent payments to credit bureaus to help build credit. After six months of payments, I discovered none of my rent payments have been reported. I have been paying the monthly service fee throughout. This service has delivered zero value. I want a full refund of all service fees paid and immediate back-reporting of all my on-time payments for the past six months as promised. Please also audit all customers enrolled in this service.
output: Complaint about Rent Reporting Service Failing to Report Payments

input: I received a notice that your bank is closing all accounts in my country due to changes in your international banking policy. I was given 30 days notice. I have significant funds in these accounts and the transfer process is extremely complex with my alternative bank. 30 days is completely insufficient notice for such a major change. I request at least 90 days to properly transition my funds and financial relationships. Please also provide dedicated support for affected international customers during this transition.
output: Complaint about Insufficient Notice for International Account Closure

input: I have a high-yield savings account with a rate advertised as 4.5% APY. Last month, the rate was reduced to 3.8% without any notification. I only discovered this when reviewing my interest credit. While I understand rates can change, I should have received advance notice so I could make informed decisions about where to keep my savings. I would like explanation of when and why the rate changed and a commitment to provide advance notice for future rate reductions of 0.25% or more.
output: Complaint about High-Yield Savings Rate Reduction Without Notice

input: I requested a wire transfer recall after sending funds to an incorrect account. I notified your bank within 30 minutes of the transfer. It has been two weeks and the recall has not been completed. I was told the receiving bank 'has not responded' but your team does not appear to be escalating the matter. $25,000 of my funds are effectively lost. I need your bank to take immediate and aggressive action to recover these funds, including escalating to regulatory authorities if necessary.
output: Complaint about Wire Transfer Recall Not Being Pursued

input: I enrolled my minor child in a custodial savings account specifically for educational savings. Your bank recently restructured these accounts and converted them to standard savings accounts, eliminating certain tax-advantaged features I was relying on. I received no notice of this change. The whole purpose of opening this account type was for the specific features now removed. I want my account restored to its original terms or compensation for the lost benefits. Please honor the terms under which customers originally opened these accounts.
output: Complaint about Custodial Account Features Removed Without Notice

input: I use your bank's invoicing and payment collection tools for my freelance business. Last month, the payment collection feature stopped processing credit card payments from my clients. Several clients have reported that their payments fail when using the link I send them. This is directly impacting my income. I have contacted tech support three times and each time I am told 'engineers are working on it.' I need a concrete resolution timeline or a workaround immediately. Please prioritize fixing payment collection tools that affect customers' livelihoods.
output: Complaint about Business Payment Collection Tool Failure

input: I was informed by another financial institution that a hard inquiry from your bank appears on my credit report, but I have never applied for any product with your bank. This unauthorized inquiry has slightly lowered my credit score. When I contacted your bank, no one could find any record of an application under my information. I believe this may be identity fraud. I need the unauthorized inquiry removed from all three credit bureaus and a full investigation into how my information was used to generate an inquiry.
output: Complaint about Unauthorized Hard Inquiry on Credit Report

input: Your bank's mobile check deposit feature rejected my government-issued check citing 'image quality issues' despite multiple high-quality attempts. I then drove to the branch to deposit it in person. The teller ran it through and it was initially accepted but then returned two weeks later as 'not negotiable.' The check is a legitimate state tax refund. I am now stuck with an uncashable check and your bank charged me a returned item fee. Please investigate this and help me resolve the check and waive the fee.
output: Complaint about Government Check Rejected as Not Negotiable

input: I applied for your bank's small business grant program which was advertised on your website. I submitted a complete application and was told I would receive a decision within 30 days. It has been four months with no communication. When I call the grant program number, it goes to voicemail and calls are never returned. I believe this may be a misleading marketing initiative with no real intent to fund applicants. Please provide an immediate update on my application or acknowledge that the program is no longer active.
output: Complaint about Small Business Grant Program Application Ignored

input: I paid off my home equity loan last month and requested a lien release so my property title is clear. It has been six weeks and the lien has not been released with the county recorder. My attorney says this is needed for a pending property sale that is now being delayed. Many states require lien releases within a specific timeframe. Please process my lien release immediately and have your title team contact my attorney to expedite recording. This delay is costing me significant money in delayed closing.
output: Complaint about Delayed Mortgage Lien Release After Payoff

input: I have been a platinum-tier customer for 12 years and your new account management system downgraded my status to basic tier, removing all my benefits. When I called, I was told my accounts were 'not properly linked' in the new system. This is a bank error that has stripped me of benefits I have earned and maintained. I want my platinum status reinstated immediately along with all associated benefits retroactively for the period they were removed. Please also prioritize customers affected by your system migration issues.
output: Complaint about Customer Tier Status Lost During System Migration

input: I use your bank's virtual card number feature for online shopping. A virtual card number I used for a recurring subscription was suddenly deactivated without notice. As a result, my subscription was cancelled and I lost access to an online service I depend on for work. I then had to spend hours reinstating the subscription and updating payment information. I need an explanation for why the virtual card was deactivated and compensation for the disruption caused. Please provide advance notice before deactivating virtual card numbers.
output: Complaint about Virtual Card Number Deactivated Without Notice
